title: ConfidenceEnvelope
description: Confidence envelope embedded in every blackboard contribution. The blackboard hosts ONLY confidence-bearing identifications (score < 1.0 by construction); deterministic tool outputs (SCIP, CPG, SBOM, framework inventory, IaC inventory, code graph) flow in-memory between co-located producer and consumer KSs via SourcerContext and are NEVER persisted on the blackboard. The 'method' string identifies the scoring scheme (e.g. 'leiden+modularity', 'taint-coverage', 'rule-vote') and the 'factors' array carries explainability fragments.

score.description: Confidence score in [0, 1). A blackboard contribution with score == 1.0 is forbidden by construction (would be a deterministic fact, not an identification).

factors.description: Explainability fragments contributing to the score.
